source.name: Open3Dhk / LandsD 3D Digital Map terrain tiles (self-hosted)
source.method: Draco glTF vertices linearly interpolated onto the analysis grid

grid.verticalDatum: mPD (as supplied by the tile; not independently checked)

caveats: Surface of the terrain tile mesh, not a surveyed DTM release.
Mesh spacing sets the true resolution; the 5 m grid is the analysis convention.
The tiles carry texture over a draped mesh; bare-earth under structures is as modelled by LandsD.
